environment.description: Same Flask application deployed in Kubernetes pod with securityContext specifying runAsNonRoot: true (uid 1000), readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, and capabilities drop list including CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN. Pod uses emptyDir volume for /var/log/app with medium: Memory and sizeLimit: 10Mi. Fluentd sidecar reads from the emptyDir with a custom parser that applies RFC 5424 structured data normalization, replacing control characters (0x00-0x1F except 0x09) and enforcing single-line output per log entry via gsub plugin with pattern /[\r\n]/ replacement '_NEWLINE_'. The fluentd output plugin writes to Elasticsearch with a strict ingest pipeline that rejects documents containing the substring 'AUDIT' in non-audit indices.

config.elasticsearch_ingest_pipeline: strict single-line enforcement, control char stripping
